topic.label: Requires new clean power for data centers
topic.description: Whether new data centers should have to bring or pay for new clean or renewable electricity supply.
topic.suggested_question: Should new data centers in this district be required to bring new clean power with them? Why or why not?

statement.quote_text: My view is we should only build them if they bring new clean power with them.
statement.context_before: A lot of you have asked me about the data center proposal on Route 9.
statement.context_after: I don't want families paying higher electric bills so a data center can plug in.
